events.verdict: Jones Jr. (LAC) contests the jump shot attempt and makes marginal contact with Simons' (POR) non-shooting arm that does not impact his follow-through.
Zubac (LAC) legally contests Ayton's (POR) shot attempt near the rim.
Grant (POR) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Avdija (POR) initiates contact with Zubac's (LAC) right arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Powell (LAC) cleanly blocks Simons' (POR) driving shot attempt.
Avdija (POR) cleanly blocks Powell's (LAC) shot attempt before the ball touches the backboard.
Powell (LAC) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.

Ayton (POR) and Zubac (LAC) briefly engage and disengage during the throw-in. Although Ayton has a hand placed on Zubac's back, he does not use him as leverage to get to the pass and the contact is marginal.
Zubac (LAC) commits a take foul on Ayton (POR).
